# aibris v0.8.4

This release versioned the `scan --json` contract and established the Windows
support contract.

## Highlights

- `aibris scan --json` now emits a top-level `schema_version` and a canonical
  `items` array representing every debris category. The historical `worktrees`
  field remains as a documented 0.x compatibility alias that mirrors `items`
  exactly, so existing consumers are unaffected.
- A Windows support contract is now documented (`docs/WINDOWS.md`) and indexed
  from the README. Windows archives remain **experimental**: native
  installation, verified behavior, and unaudited boundaries are described
  there.

## Windows status

Windows archives are **experimental**. The supported shape is the `amd64` /
`arm64` Windows zip archives cross-built by GoReleaser and listed in
`checksums.txt`. Native users verify the SHA-256 and place `aibris.exe` on the
PATH; `install.sh` remains Unix-only. Pull-request CI builds and exercises the
native executable (`--version`, `--help`, isolated `scan --json`), home /
cache isolation, recorded-cwd volume safety, and reparse-point cleanup
protection on `windows-latest`. A Windows version matrix is not published.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sungjunlee/aibris/blob/v0.8.4/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete curated change list.
